package.name: MachinaQCAM
package.description: Classify machining features and required CNC operations for the active document via MachinaQ, from inside FreeCAD's CAM workbench.

workbench.name: MachinaQCAM
workbench.description: Adds a standalone "MachinaQ" workbench with a "Classify Feature" command that submits the active document to a running MachinaQ API server and reports its feature/operation classification.
